title: Tokenized Release Reservation for Top Customers
creator: Maya Chen
description: Introduce a tokenized Release Reservation system that lets strategic customers reserve prioritized delivery windows (release tokens) for customer-driven roadmap items. Tokens are earned, purchased, or granted based on contractual tier, renewal velocity, and risk signals. Reservations are redeemable for sprint-level prioritization (within defined SLAs) and integrate with existing intake, canary, and rollback policies. Goal: reduce ad-hoc escalation work, make commitments quantifiable, and enable predictable resource planning for Dedicated/Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: A reservation token model is documented (accrual, expiry, transfer, consumption rules)
Console UI mockup for token purchase/reservation flow is reviewed and signed off by Design
API endpoints for granting/redeeming tokens are specified and have an initial backend stub
Priority routing honors redeemed reservations and returns telemetry in the Console (latency, fulfillment time, failure reason)
Fallback policy defined: automatic downgrade to expedited paid lane or scheduled slot if reservation cannot be fulfilled
Pilot cohort of 3 strategic customers agree to terms and participate in a 6-week pilot

open_questions: Should tokens be transferable between accounts under the same enterprise org?
What is the minimum SLA window we guarantee (1 sprint vs 2 sprints)?
How do tokens interact with canary rollouts and rollback safety checks?
Billing model: refundable credit vs bonus token — which is preferred by finance for revenue recognition?
Operational cost: what is the telemetry cost for trace-level audit of token fulfillment?
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Design & Spec) - finalize model and acceptance criteria (Mar 2026)
Phase 1 (Pilot) - onboard 3 Lighthouse accounts, add runtime routing hook, basic Console UX (Apr-May 2026)
Phase 2 (Measure) - collect fulfillment metrics, customer satisfaction, failure modes; iterate accrual rules (Jun 2026)
Phase 3 (Scale) - formalize commercial appendix, add token purchase flow and billing integration (Q3 2026)
